name: Advanced Li-metal solid-state pack
physical_basis: Li-metal anode / solid electrolyte; electrochemical storage
what_is_new: Higher cell energy and safety than LFP; not a new source
predicted_performance: 300-400 Wh/kg cell; 200-260 Wh/kg pack; 10 kWh pack ~40-50 kg; system ~50-65 kg
assumptions: Pack packaging 1.25; 92% round trip; 95% converter; 90% DoD
strongest_counterargument: Solid-state interfaces and manufacturing may not deliver pack-level gains; cost may exceed $400/kWh
success_criteria: >=250 Wh/kg pack at C/2; >=500 cycles; <=$400/kWh; closed energy balance
falsification_stop: <250 Wh/kg pack; <500 cycles; >$400/kWh; thermal runaway without containment
safety_regulatory: Li-metal reactivity; UN38.3 transport; fire containment
next_if_pass: Model at M1; then cell test
next_if_fail: Keep as literature option; do not model
ip_concerns: Solid-state/Li-metal patents dense; freedom-to-operate review before any cell design

name: Li-S or Li-air step-change storage
what_is_new: Theoretical cell energy far above Li-ion; practical barriers
conversion_path: Grid charge (or O2) -> cell -> converter -> load
predicted_performance: 300-500 Wh/kg cell claim; practical pack lower; cycle life 100-500; Li-air round-trip poor
uncertainty: Very high; chemistry and cycle life
assumptions: Practical pack 200-300 Wh/kg; 60-80% round-trip; replaceable cells
strongest_counterargument: Cycle life, self-discharge, electrolyte/air handling, and round-trip losses may erase the gain
success_criteria: >=200 Wh/kg pack; >=100 cycles; round-trip >=60%; safe containment
next_if_pass: Model at M1/M3; then cell test
ip_concerns: Li-S/Li-air patents dense; materials and electrolyte IP; review before samples

name: Micro-fission Stirling for long-duration remote
what_is_new: High energy density and 24/7 operation for M2; not portable
predicted_performance: 1 kWe ground test; 10 kWe design concept; system 10^2-10^3 kg; fuel mass negligible; shielding/regulatory dominate
assumptions: Reactor + reflector + shield + radiator + control; no 35 kg claim
strongest_counterargument: System mass, launch/regulatory cost, and safety make it irrelevant to M1; fuel is not the constraint
cheapest_decisive_test: Paper study + NTRS data; no nuclear experiment
success_criteria: System <500 kg for 1 kWe at M2; regulatory path exists; cost within M2
falsification_stop: System >500 kg per kWe; no regulatory path; cost >M2 budget
safety_regulatory: Nuclear licensing; radiation; export control; no home experiment
next_if_pass: Design M2 paper concept; seek partner
next_if_fail: Do not model; keep as M2 note
ip_concerns: Nuclear technology export control; DOE/NNSA and licensee IP; no private build

name: TPV plus thermal store for stationary heat-to-power
physical_basis: External heat -> emitter -> TPV cells -> electricity
what_is_new: High-temperature TPV cell efficiency; thermal storage decouples heat and power
predicted_performance: Usable TPV store 0.06-0.10 kWh/kg; 10 kWh electric needs ~39 kWh thermal; graphite 387-645 kg; store alone 484-806 kg before emitter/cells/radiator; system far above 257 kg.
assumptions: 0.06-0.10 kWh/kg usable at >=1500 C emitter; 0.28 kWh/kg is full-swing and not usable; 32% cell x 0.85 spectral x 0.95 converter
strongest_counterargument: External heat is not a portable source; store mass and standby loss dominate; cell cost high
cheapest_decisive_test: Paper study + vendor data; no high-T experiment
success_criteria: System >=20%; usable store >=1 kWh/kg; heat source co-located; standby loss declared
falsification_stop: System <20%; usable store <1 kWh/kg; no co-located heat; >$1/W
next_if_fail: Do not model for M1; keep M4 note
ip_concerns: III-V TPV cell and selective-emitter patents; university/industry license likely

name: H2 fuel cell with advanced tank
physical_basis: H2 oxidation -> PEM fuel cell -> electricity
what_is_new: Lightweight tank + high-efficiency stack for M1/M2
conversion_path: H2 storage -> PEM stack -> converter -> load
predicted_performance: 45-55% LHV; 10 kWh needs ~0.6 kg H2; 5 wt% tank ~12.6 kg; C1 average-sized 1.4 kW stack ~11.6 kg + 0.3 kWh buffer; system ~56 kg. Direct 6.3 kW stack variant ~50 kg stack, system >60 kg.
uncertainty: Medium-high; tank mass, stack cost, H2 price
assumptions: 5 wt% system tank; 50% LHV; 8 kg/kW stack; 95% converter
strongest_counterargument: Tank and stack mass; H2 cost and logistics; 6 kW stack oversizing
success_criteria: C1 system <=35 kg for M1; H2 <=$4/kg; tank >=5 wt%; leak-safe. 60 kg is only an intermediate milestone, not a pass.
falsification_stop: C1 system >35 kg; H2 >$4/kg; tank <5 wt%; leak/embrittlement
safety_regulatory: High-pressure H2; fire; embrittlement; certified lab
next_if_fail: Keep as M2 option; stop M1
ip_concerns: PEM stack and 700 bar tank patents; supplier IP; no claim without license review

name: Thermionic AMTEC or Stirling converter
predicted_performance: 10-40% depending on T and maturity; high-T materials; waste heat; life uncertain
assumptions: Hot side 800-1500 K; cold side 300-400 K; recuperation; radiator
strongest_counterargument: Life and efficiency at compact scale are unproven; high-T materials and seals dominate
success_criteria: System >=15%; >=5,000 h life; <=5 kg/kW; closed heat balance
ip_concerns: AMTEC/thermionic patents; materials and seal IP; early FTO review

name: Flywheel or supercapacitor pulse buffer
what_is_new: High power and cycle life for M3 pulses; not energy
predicted_performance: Supercap 6 Wh/kg; 0.05 kWh ~8 kg; flywheel 20-100 Wh/kg; 0.05 kWh ~0.5-2.5 kg plus containment
assumptions: 0.05 kWh buffer; 90% round-trip; containment mass included
strongest_counterargument: Adds mass without mission energy; A2 already shows no benefit at M1; flywheel containment/safety
success_criteria: Buffer <=5 kg for 0.05 kWh; round-trip >=90%; containment safe
ip_concerns: Flywheel/supercap patents; containment and control IP; low novelty risk

name: New mechanism LENR over-unity zero-point
physical_basis: No accepted reproducible mechanism; net output would violate conservation
what_is_new: A genuinely new source would be revolutionary if real
primary_source: N12 (negative review); no positive peer-reviewed replication
assumptions: Full energy balance; calibration; independent replication
strongest_counterargument: All known claims fail reproducibility, calibration, or background exclusion; patents are not proof
cheapest_decisive_test: Pre-registered calorimetry with full energy balance and independent replication
success_criteria: A reproducible net output with accounted source and no conventional explanation
falsification_stop: Any net-output claim without source; calibration/background not excluded; no replication
safety_regulatory: Unknown; could be hazardous; no home experiment
next_if_pass: Only after a specific reproducible claim passes paper screen
next_if_fail: Close the track; record negative result
ip_concerns: No valid IP expected for perpetual motion; any claim would face scientific and patent validity challenge
